scope_guards: Air-quality relevance depends on the proposal, location, receptors and baseline; an AQMA flag is not a parcel-level outcome.
Construction, operation and decommissioning emissions are assessed separately where relevant.
Public-health air quality, protected-site deposition and environmental-permit controls are related but distinct.
Natural England standing advice has stated applicability limits and does not cover NSIPs or local plans.
In-combination screening must use current background and other-project evidence; APIS background is not duplicated.
LAQM annual reviews, AQMAs and action plans do not themselves approve or refuse a development.
National target trajectories are not substituted for site-specific dispersion or impact evidence.
No score or promotion is written without exact parcel/receptor geometry, current baseline, proposal emissions, assessment and planning evidence.
